_about: Real dimensions of purchased parts for CAD (mm, g). 'confidence': drawing = official mechanical drawing, step = measured from the vendor STEP with FreeCAD, datasheet = manufacturer spec, listing = retailer listing, estimate = not yet sourced. 'model_check' compares an MJCF geom's full dimensions against the real envelope (tools/check_cad_clearances.py). Vendor files: tools/fetch_vendor_cad.sh.

parts.name: SteadyWin GIM6010-8 (with GDS68 driver)
parts.envelope: Overall 44.0 axial x Ø80 (STEP bbox; something reaches R43.3 = Ø86.6 radially, likely the connector: check on arrival). Stack along the axis: driver cover Ø57 x 11 | housing Ø80 x 26 | output steps 7 (Ø47 +0/-0.03 spigot 3.5 long, then the hub).
mounting: Housing, both faces: 8x M3 depth 5 on Ø74 ±0.10 PCD
Output hub: 6x M3 depth 5 on Ø25 ±0.10 PCD, 3x Ø4 ±0.05 dowel holes on Ø20.4 PCD
Locating spigot: Ø47 +0/-0.03 x 3.5 (output side)
Driver PCB 47 x 47 x 8.65, 4x M2; connectors: 2+2 power/CAN terminal, USB-C
Optional output-shaft variant: Ø14 +0/-0.03 x 15 shaft with a Ø5 x 3 cross hole / key slot; housing holes then 8x M3 depth 4.5 (back) and depth 4 (front) (6010-8 Output Shaft drawing)
parts.loads: Rated 5 N*m, stall 11 N*m, 420 rpm max. Bearing load limits not published in the manual: ask SteadyWin.
parts.verify: Radial protrusion (Ø86.6 bbox), connector exit direction, which face your driver variant puts the connector on.

parts.name: SteadyWin GIM4305-10SHS (with front cover, integrated driver)
parts.envelope: Overall 33.0 axial x Ø53 (drawing + STEP). Listings say 'Ø53 x 26', which is the housing only. Stack: output step Ø37 x 1 | housing Ø53 x 26 | rear driver boss Ø40 x 6. The no-front-cover variant is 31 (2 + 23 + 6) but must not be run until its bearing is retained by your part.
mounting: Output (rotor): 3x M3 effective depth 4 on Ø27 PCD
Housing, output face: 3x M2.5 effective depth 5 on Ø47.5 PCD
Housing, rear face: 6x M2.5 depth 3 on Ø47.5 PCD; screws longer than 3 mm engagement damage the motor
parts.loads: Max axial 125 N, max radial 500 N (listing). Rated 1.0 N*m, stall 3.47 N*m.
parts.verify: Axial/radial load limits with SteadyWin (the wheel motors carry the robot's weight and landing loads radially, and side loads axially).

parts.name: Feetech STS3215 serial bus servo, 7.4 V
parts.envelope: 45.2 x 24.7 x 35 body; 25T output spline
mounting: Use the STS3215 model in the Open Duck Mini Onshape CAD (same servo, same brackets)
parts.verify: Hole pattern from the Open Duck Mini CAD.

parts.name: Micro servo, MG90S (metal gear) or SG90
parts.envelope: MG90S 22.8 x 12.2 x 28.5 body, ~32.5 across the mounting tabs; SG90 22.2 x 11.8 x 31, 9 g
mounting: 2x tab holes, spacing ~27.5 (measure)
parts.verify: Tab hole spacing and horn height on the part you buy. The model assumes 9 g (SG90); MG90S adds 4.4 g per side in the head.

parts.name: 6S2P 21700 pack (12x Molicel P45B)
parts.envelope: Cell max Ø21.55 x 70.15, <= 70 g (Molicel datasheet). 4 x 3 cells lying along x: bare 70.2 x 86.2 x 64.7; +1.5 per side for nickel strip, fish paper and wrap = 73 x 89 x 68
mounting: Strap or clamp in a tray; no holes. Balance lead + main leads to the BMS
parts.verify: Final pack envelope from the builder / your layout.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi 5
parts.envelope: PCB 85 x 56; 90.0 x 57.7 x 19.8 including connector overhang (STEP)
mounting: 4x Ø2.7 (M2.5) holes on a 58 x 49 rectangle, 3.5 from the PCB edges (HAT+ standard)
parts.verify: Leave room for USB/Ethernet plugs and the cooler's fan inlet.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 26 TOPS (with Active Cooler underneath)
parts.envelope: 65.1 x 56.7 x 5.5; on a 16 mm stacking header above the Pi (clears the Active Cooler)
mounting: Same 58 x 49 hole pattern as the Pi, supplied spacers

parts.name: PJRC Teensy 4.0 (+ 2x CAN transceiver breakouts on a carrier)
parts.envelope: Teensy 35.6 x 17.8 (1.4 x 0.7 in); the model box (42 x 22 x 7) is the carrier
mounting: No mounting holes: socket it on a carrier PCB or perfboard with M2.5 holes
parts.verify: Carrier size once the transceivers, level shifter, fan MOSFET and connectors are laid out. Cut the VUSB-VIN pad: it is fed from the Pi buck and also gets 5 V over USB from the Pi.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 (standard)
parts.envelope: PCB 25 x 23.862 x 1.12; 11.3 deep including the lens (wide: 12.0). Lens holder 10.8 x 10.8, lens Ø5.75 (wide Ø6.95). FOV 66 x 41 deg (wide 102 x 67)
mounting: 4x Ø2.2 (M2) holes, 21 apart horizontally (2 from each side edge); vertical spacing and the lens-axis height from the drawing in the product brief
parts.verify: Set the 70 mm baseline between lens axes, not PCB centres.

parts.name: WS2812B 12-LED ring (Adafruit NeoPixel Ring 12 class)
parts.envelope: Ø37 OD, Ø23 ID, ~3.5 thick with LEDs
mounting: No holes: clamp or glue behind a diffuser
parts.verify: Ø23 ID clears the Camera Module 3 lens holder (10.8 square = 15.3 across corners).

parts.name: Adafruit 3968 speaker, 40 mm, 4 ohm, 3 W (5 W max)
parts.envelope: Ø40 x 20 overall (Adafruit spec; Digi-Key: seated height max 20.00). Modelled as a 2 mm rim, a tapered basket and a Ø22 magnet cup, cone outward under the tail-top grille
mounting: No tabs or holes: clamp it by its rim against the inside of the tail's top face (a printed ring or a bead of hot glue)
parts.verify: Rim width on arrival (Adafruit redesigned the cone in January 2024).

parts.name: MAX98357A I2S amplifier breakout
parts.envelope: ~18 x 19 PCB

parts.name: INMP441 I2S MEMS microphone breakout
parts.envelope: ~Ø14 round PCB; acoustic port on the bottom of the PCB
parts.verify: Port side faces the head's mic hole.

parts.name: RAFI LUMOTAST 22 latching e-stop, 1.15.105.032/0000 (NC + NO, no indicator) or 1.15.105.031/0000 (with status indicator)
parts.envelope: Ø22.3 panel cutout, ring nut from the rear, 17.9 mm behind the panel (17.6 on one Digi-Key page), 0.8 mm tab terminals, IP65, twist to release, 2.5 A 250 V. Head size not published: modelled Ø32 x 20 proud
parts.confidence: listing (series data; per-part pages not readable)
parts.verify: Confirm on the Digi-Key page that the part has an NO contact as well as the NC (the anti-spark switch's button wiring needs both), and the mushroom size. Digi-Key showed 0 in stock for both when checked (Oct 2026).

parts.name: Heltec 6S/7S 80 A split-port BMS, 3.7 V Li-ion, set for 6S
parts.envelope: 83 x 55 x 8 (Heltec listing). Modelled on edge across the bay just ahead of the pack (x 12..20), pads toward -y
parts.verify: Ask Heltec for the discharge over-current delay (it must ride through 80 A for 50 ms; a 200 A limit suggests it will, but no delay is published) and the charge-port current rating (>= 4 A). Weight is an estimate.
parts.loads: 80 A continuous, 200 A current-limit protection (listing); balance 83 mA

parts.name: Flipsky Antispark Switch Pro V3.0, heatsink version (SKU ANSPFS14SH)
parts.envelope: 42.2 x 33 x 26.6 with heatsink and heat shrink, 12 AWG leads (Flipsky). 3-14S, 60 A continuous with the heatsink (100 A with the aluminium-PCB version, 83.9 x 45 x 17), 200 A max. Switches the battery negative
mounting: Lies on the tail shelf, leads along y
parts.verify: Its button is a 3-wire latching changeover (S common, + = NO, - = NC); the e-stop's contacts replace it (see README). Bench-test that pressing the e-stop switches it off before relying on it. Weight is an estimate.

parts.name: 40 A blade fuse + inline holder
parts.envelope: ~24 x 10 x 20 holder; modeled 24 x 10 x 20

parts.name: Pololu D36V50F5 (5 V, Pi and peripherals) x2 + D36V50F7 (7.5 V, head servos) x1
parts.envelope: 25.4 x 25.4 x 9.5 each, 3x M2 holes (Ø2.18), 5.5-50 V in. Pololu graph at 24 V in, room temperature, still air: ~7.3 A (5 V), ~6.4 A (7.5 V)
parts.verify: No published ambient rating: the bay reaches 45-50 C, so expect less than the room-temperature figures (thermal shutdown protects them). The 7.5 V board covers the head servos' ~1 A typical; all four STS3215 stalled at once (~11 A) would trip it. The Pi gets 5.0 V, not 5.1: keep its 20 AWG feed short.

parts.name: Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter (A)
parts.envelope: Modelled on the front bulkhead (envelope estimated)
parts.verify: Envelope and mounting holes on arrival.

parts.name: CAN transceiver breakout, 3.3 V (SN65HVD230)
parts.envelope: ~10 x 15 PCB; modelled as part of the Teensy carrier
mounting: Solder to the carrier; 120 ohm terminator fitted on most SN65HVD230 boards (keep it: the Teensy is one end of each bus)
parts.verify: If you use an MCP2562FD instead: VDD must be 5 V (VIO 3.3 V for the Teensy), and fit the 120 ohm yourself.

parts.name: 74AHCT125 quad level shifter (WS2812B data)
parts.envelope: DIP-14 or SOIC-14; on the Teensy carrier (not modelled)

parts.name: 40 x 40 x 10 mm 5 V PWM fan (Noctua NF-A4x10 5V PWM)
parts.envelope: 40 x 40 x 10; 4x M3 on 32 mm
mounting: 4x M3 on the rear bulkhead's tail face, Ø38 bore
parts.verify: 25 kHz PWM input is open-drain with an internal pull-up to 5 V: drive it from Teensy pin 5 through a 2N7002, never directly.

parts.name: Arducam UB0234 2MP wide-angle USB 2.0 camera board (OV2710, M12 lens)
parts.envelope: 32 x 32 board, 105 deg horizontal FOV (listing). Lens holder and depth as modelled (15 x 15, estimate)
mounting: 4 posts off the front cap: M2 self-tapping at the bottom corners, locating pins at the top
parts.verify: Hole positions and the USB plug's exit on arrival (Arducam's own pages weren't readable).

parts.name: GX16-2 aviation panel socket + plug (charge input)
parts.envelope: Thread Ø16 (panel hole Ø16.2), flange on the front, solder cups to ~30 behind the panel
parts.loads: Contacts ~5 A: 5 A fuse on the charge lead
parts.verify: The panel pins are at pack voltage when unplugged unless the charge lead has a series diode (fitted: see README).

parts.name: 1 W LED on a 15 x 12 board + AO3400 MOSFET board + 6.8 ohm 1 W resistor
parts.envelope: LED board 15 x 12 (the ODM flashlight insert's pocket); MOSFET board modelled in the head
parts.verify: Use a MOSFET fully on at 3.3 V gate drive (AO3400 class, not IRLZ44N). 6.8 ohm sets ~270 mA from 5 V at Vf ~3.2 V; or a 350 mA constant-current driver.

parts.name: 6S Li-ion charger, 25.2 V CC/CV, 3-4 A
parts.envelope: External brick (not on the robot)
parts.verify: Fit the GX16 plug to its output lead, observing polarity.

parts.name: Smooth-On VytaFlex 40 urethane rubber (tire treads)
parts.envelope: Cast tread per wheel: Ø150 OD x 32 wide, 6 thick (hub rim Ø138), crowned edges R4; ~87 cm³ each. Mass assumes density ~1.0 (estimate)
mounting: Mechanically keyed to the printed hub: 12x Ø3 axial through-holes + circumferential grooves (no bond to PLA/PETG)
parts.loads: Shore 40A, 1:1 by volume, 30 min pot life, 16 h demold (Smooth-On). Hub sees ~250 N radial on landings (design_loads.md)
parts.confidence: datasheet (material); tread geometry is the design
parts.verify: Density and full-cure time on the datasheet; measure μ on your floors (cad/tires.md).
